description: This file defines the BucketEndpointMiddleware class used to modify S3 request hostnames and paths for bucket endpoints in the AWS SDK for PHP. It contains methods for removing bucket references from URLs and handling bucket-specific configurations.

classes.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware to adjust request host and path for bucket endpoint configuration in AWS S3 requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that instantiates BucketEndpointMiddleware with a given handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the command and request, modifying the request if a bucket is specified and not excluded.

methods.name: removeBucketFromPath
methods.description: Removes the bucket name from the request path, considering multiple occurrences.

methods.name: removeDuplicateBucketFromHost
methods.description: Removes duplicate bucket names from the host if present.

methods.name: getBucketNameOccurrencesInKey
methods.description: Counts how many times the bucket name appears in the key segments.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request URI by removing bucket info from path and host, and encodes the key.
